task.emphasis: Multiple equipment scales, removable filter assemblies, interchangeable mixer accessories, and staged flow-cell loading.
task.selected_scope: Use only the selected fresh-sample PM10 membrane branch and the provided ten-stage mechanical sequence. Prepared contents and internal sampling/processing/sequencing behavior remain state abstractions. interpretation_notes: The cabinet, sequencer and other large devices may be infeasible in an unspecified compact layout. Report the measured interface reach/space conflict; do not silently rescale hardware or delete stages. The close bucket/tube fit requires evidence, not a claim based solely on nominal dimensions.

scoring.quality_normalization: Use each unit result_kind: ordinal_0_4 => rating/4; ordinal_0_2 => rating/2; binary => rating.

evidence_requirements.description: Complete simulator scene, referenced assets, collision geometry, joints, materials, physical parameters, fixtures and mapping from package asset IDs to scene bodies/joints/sites. Use separate instance IDs for repeated objects.
Initial state, robot and table configuration, simulator/version, timestep, solver/controller settings, seed, control sequence or executable policy, and a replay entry point with dependency versions.
Time-indexed robot joint state, commands, object poses/velocities, relevant contact/constraint data, gripper/tool states and device states at sufficient resolution for the claimed checks.
Stage/event log with object IDs, source/destination content-state ledger, device transitions, retries and error messages. Events are claims to verify against E1/E3, not proof by themselves.
Synchronized overall and interaction views sufficient to inspect the relevant geometry/contact; calibrated views or measurement overlays for dimensional claims.
Fixture assembly/BOM, installation/support interfaces, degrees of freedom, extra actuators, tool changes, intervention log and mapping of each main feature to its operational purpose.

evaluation_profile.dependency_scope: Per assessment unit; an unresolved dependency never blocks unrelated checks.
legacy_requirements: The pinned mobile dual-arm robot model, per-arm grippers and limits; declared initial base/lift/arm states, designed room, tables, docking poses and equipment/support regions.

Permitted interfaces for software-controlled devices, declared pre-installed fixtures and any allowance for extra actuators or human interventions. Newly generated equipment must not silently add another robot.

A tolerance register: source nominal/range, provenance, units, measurement method and evaluator allowance. Separate geometric export precision, numerical contact tolerance and real manufacturing uncertainty. A nominally positive mating gap alone does not establish reliable fit.

Contact/penetration, seating, stability and measurement windows appropriate to each object/interface. Require a short specified settling window for stable placement, not a single lucky frame. Do not silently impose unsupported physical-force limits.
Time representation for abstract device dwell states, evidence sampling rate, test resets, retry/compute budget and, if used, a comparable efficiency reference.

geometry_and_mating.requirement: Preserve the 203.2 x 254 mm membrane and separate holder/wrapper; folded weighing geometry fits the 100 mm pan and enclosure without shrinking the membrane. Distinguish nominal dish diameter from the stated 89.43 mm body diameter.
Check the 1300 x 802 x 1522 mm cabinet body, separate bracket, 750 mm worktop height and 200 mm normal opening; the 533 mm maximum is not the default operating opening.
Check the capped tube height 115.80 mm against the selected 116 mm bucket-cover envelope. The 0.20 mm nominal difference is not proof of clearance; evaluate both cover and adapter fit.
Retain all four swing buckets, selected adapters and separate bucket covers. Check the stated 700 x 608 x 345 mm body envelope and selected load configuration.
Check the 47 mm membrane seat, removable funnel cup/base, stopper, filter bottle and connected pump hose; geometry must agree with the declared fluid-path topology.
Check screw-cap grinding tubes against the immersion rack and horizontal holder; preserve a separate cup head and 24-position holder with a real exchange interface.
Check microtube/rotor/magnet/rack fit and refrigerator access. Separate the 1.5 ml, 2 ml and screw-cap tube geometries; the magnetic stand is not a universal reaction-tube holder.
Check five selected single-channel pipettes, compatible detachable tips and accessible boxes; pipette and tip working ranges must cover each declared transfer.
Preserve the dedicated 6 x 16 mm glass-tube body, slit cap, internal insert, clamp, separate cooler and hose space; that tube-body dimension is not the whole capped assembly.
Check the 237 x 485 x 245 mm thermal cycler, compatible 0.2 ml individual tubes, separate loading bracket and countertop base; the base stays outside the heated block.
Keep the plate, protective cover, peelable film, manifold, flow cell, clamps, template strip and sipper comb separable; inspect the selected carrier arrangement rather than a single fused model.

Check the full 1186 x 760 x 940 mm sequencer body, separate priming/sample flow cells, source racks, eight collection tubes and compatible conical-bottom bottles/caps; preserve rack-position identities.

mechanisms.requirement: The holder opens/clamps/releases, the membrane/wrapper can fold and unfold, and the balance has sliding side doors; cutting changes the membrane representation through supported contact.
Screw caps and attached caps remain distinct mechanisms; main/rotor/bucket covers and swing buckets move independently with valid stop/unlock behavior.
Cup separation, membrane retention, pump control and pressure-release state are available without the membrane passing through its support.
Bath access, anti-floating support, mixer-head exchange, horizontal-tube clipping and refrigerator door/rack access are executable local functions.
Pipettes expose plunger stops, adjustment and ejection; the magnetic rack permits physical tube/rack removal rather than attracting whole tubes as magnetic objects.
Slit-cap access and clamp installation work independently of the thermal-cycler bracket/lid interfaces; configured software starts are not invented hardware buttons.
The plate clamp, designated peelable film, manifold/outlet coupling, sipper clips and flow-cell clamp can be operated individually.
Aspiration tubes lift/lock/lower, reagent racks slide, flow-cell control positions operate in sequence and waste lines can be routed to the collection tubes then restored.

layout.requirement: Cabinet entry at the normal window opening accommodates the holder, filter assembly and robot tool without blocking front/rear grilles.
Retain the supplied thermal-cycler overhead/rear spaces and the clusterer open-lid height, including loading-tool space.
Account for the full sequencer, the projecting waste bottle and keyboard tray, stated service clearances, open racks and a separate collection-tube staging area.
Check actual-scale coexistence within the declared room; use declared mobile docking poses; no invisible human relay or shrunken cabinet compensates for inaccessible interfaces.
Evidence-backed compactness, not a table-count target.

motion_interactions.requirement: Track membrane grasp/support and cutting contact; an explicit contact-triggered topology abstraction is acceptable, spontaneous fragment creation is not.
Track tube/bucket/rotor loading, cover handling and stopped-rotor retrieval separately.
Inspect accessory change and dedicated-tube clamping; do not award held support to a tube floating above a head.
Inspect manifold release, flow-cell reorientation, sipper lifting and rack insertion without dragging coupled interfaces through geometry.
Track source/destination identity, accessible pipette controls, line routing and container support for repeated handling.

identity_and_dependencies.requirement: Track one original membrane and wrapper across weighing; original and secondary membranes and cut descendants retain lineage.
Grinding, fresh receiving, split, merged, reaction and final tubes have separate identities; source and balancing tubes do not replace them.
Source-defined retained/discarded content labels are preserved without scoring biological selection quality.
The sample flow cell transfers between instruments with the source-required orientation change; it is not the priming flow cell.
Collection tubes and source tubes remain separate; preserve the designated retained rack position during replacement.
Cover, clamp, connected-interface and stopped/ready dependencies apply only where specified; independent tool preparation may be reordered.
